items.title: Megakernel zoo: Claude-written single-kernel decode engines for 8 open models, up to 1.77x faster than vLLM and SGLang
items.summary: Agents wrote one GPU kernel per model that runs the whole decode loop, for eight open models from 8B to 594B, with a logit-match evaluator against an FP64 reference. Engines and an OpenAI-compatible server are open, and the pipeline can build one for your own checkpoint and GPU.

doubt.pushback: Speedup is versus vLLM and SGLang on B/H-class GPUs only; each model needs its own kernel, which repliers say adds a maintenance cost.

reception.summary: Repliers praised the strict evaluator (FP64 logit match, bit-identical under batch reordering) and asked about kernel reuse after fine-tunes and whether it transfers to consumer or GB10-class GPUs; nobody reports reproducing it.

items.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview technical report and SFT code released for an agentic diffusion language model
items.summary: DiffuSpace published the architecture, training recipe and inference experiments for Clover, a diffusion model aimed at agentic tasks, and opened its SFT code.

items.title: TRL adds Nemotron-H support to its tree-attention kernels for AsyncGRPOTrainer RL training
items.summary: A TRL contributor says Nemotron-H models can now be RL-trained with AsyncGRPOTrainer through custom tree-attention kernels. The linked pull request was still open when checked.

doubt.pushback: Pull request 8457 was still open (not merged) at check time, so 'you can now' may mean a branch.

items.title: Two DGX Sparks run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 153.5 tok/s on TensorFold, matching the published 154.0 recipe
items.summary: A home-lab test with 4 concurrent chats on two DGX Sparks reproduced a published recipe within 0.5 tok/s, using the recipe repo untouched on TensorFold.

items.title: Spark Attic v0.1.6 reclaims about 2 GB more KV cache per DGX Spark from unused display memory
items.summary: An open tool that frees display memory on a headless DGX Spark for KV cache, now also working on Ubuntu Sparks, installable by a coding agent, and self-healing after client crashes.

items.title: Reson8 Rumble-2-Flash: 0.5B Apache 2.0 speech-to-text model covering 40+ languages, card reports 6.60 WER on English
items.summary: A small open speech recognition model built on a Qwen3-ASR base that runs locally on a Mac; the WER is the model card's own figure and the poster has not yet tested it.

doubt.pushback: WER is self-reported on the model card; the Hugging Face repo was created in mid-October, so 'new' is unclear.

items.title: FrontierRSI: Abundant Labs benchmark for agents doing AI research work and multi-step post-training
items.summary: A recursive self-improvement benchmark that scores agents on AI research and engineering tasks and on multi-step agentic post-training, and Harbor now supports running it. No primary link was visible in the post text.

doubt.pushback: Repliers question the task time limits favoring faster-compute labs and one says a benchmark topped by Claude models looks off; no one reports running it.

reception.summary: Mostly congratulations from researchers, plus specific questions about time cutoffs, refusals counting in scores and optimizing for the Qwen3-4B student; no one reports trying it.

items.title: Architect Labs Frostbite: agent swarm co-designs an interaction-net CPU from ISA to final GDS
items.summary: Agents designed, verified and optimized a CPU from interaction-net theory alone, down to final layout. Repliers cite 6.02x perf/W on 10 tuned workloads and 3.83x on 15 held-out ones.

doubt.pushback: A final GDS is not working silicon and there is no independent verification; the efficiency numbers appear only in repliers' quotes of the original thread.

reception.summary: Interest in the held-out split, with specific doubts about silicon, verification and dataflow limits with ordered I/O; no one reports running it.
